answer:
The company that built the first steam locomotive to carry passengers on a public rail line was **Robert Stephenson and Company**, which was founded in **1823**.

This locomotive, known as *Locomotion No. 1*, pulled the first scheduled passenger train on a public railway when it carried passengers along the Stockton and Darlington Railway on September 27, 1825. Robert Stephenson and Company was specifically established to manufacture railway engines and was founded by George Stephenson (father), Robert Stephenson (son), Edward Pease, and Michael Longridge.
